reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask #Heartleaft Fit 10P
reviews.text: Perfect mask for sensitive skin from Olive Young! It delivers incredible soothing effects to calm my red, irritated skin instantly, gentle and non-sticky, highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 喺 Olive Young 買到嘅敏感肌 mask 完美之選！舒緩效果一流，啱啱敷上即刻可以令泛紅敏感嘅皮膚鎮靜返，溫和唔黏笠，極力推薦。

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask Heartleaf Fit 10P
reviews.text:
Really love them!
I enjoy using face masks, but hate the residue that is left on the skin after use in many masks (sometimes I even end up rinsing it with water even though it's wasteful) but these masks don't do that! The serum absorbse completely, not leaving any film or greasiness on my face. The texture of the sheat mask itself is also really lovely. I've ordered 10 and already used them up! Will probably order again.
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意！我鍾意敷 mask，但好怕好多 mask 敷完之後皮膚上會有殘留物（有時明知好嘥都要用水沖返），但呢啲 mask 唔會咁！Serum 完全被吸收，塊面冇任何薄膜或者油膩感。Sheet mask 本身嘅質地都好正。我已經訂咗 10 盒，全部用晒！好大機會再訂。

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask Honey Fit 10P
reviews.text:
These are the kind of sheet masks that are easy to keep in rotation because they’re gentle, hydrating, and just make your skin look better without overdoing anything. The essence feels lightweight but still gives a noticeable boost in moisture, and my skin looks smoother and more refreshed after using one.

What I like most is that they don’t irritate, even when my skin has been through actives like retinal or exfoliation. They feel calming and help bring everything back to a more balanced, comfortable state.

The fit is also really good—the sheet adheres well and stays in place without slipping, so it actually feels like it’s doing its job.

I see these more as a reliable maintenance mask rather than something dramatic, but that’s exactly why they work so well. Consistent, gentle hydration that supports the skin without overwhelming it.
reviews.zh:
呢種 sheet mask 好容易成為日常輪住用嘅選擇，因為佢夠溫和、保濕，而且唔會做多餘嘅嘢，皮膚用完望落就係好咗。精華感覺輕盈但仍能帶來明顯嘅保濕效果，用完之後皮膚望落更滑、更有活力。

我最鍾意嘅係佢唔會刺激皮膚，即使皮膚之前用咗 active 成分（例如 retinal 或者去角質）之後都唔會有反應。敷完感覺好舒緩，可以幫皮膚回復返平衡、舒服嘅狀態。

貼服度都好好——塊 mask 可以貼住面，唔會移位，所以真係有做到 mask 應該做嘅效果。

我會將呢款 mask 視為一款可靠嘅日常保養 mask，而唔係乜嘢戲劇性嘅產品，但正正係呢個原因所以佢先咁好用。穩定、溫和嘅保濕，可以支撐皮膚而唔會造成負擔。

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask #Heartleaft Fit 10P
reviews.text:
mask 1000/10 ⭐️✨Tried it once and my skin felt instantly plump and hydrated 💦Super soft, glowing, and refreshed right after using it!

After using it consistently, my skin looks brighter, pores appear smaller, and makeup applies so much smoother.

The essence is lightweight, not sticky at all, and absorbs quickly. The scent is soft and relaxing too 🫶🏻

If you have dry or dull skin, you NEED this in your routine.

Final thoughts: definitely repurchasing. This one actually works
reviews.zh:
mask 1000/10 ⭐️✨用咗一次之後皮膚即時變得飽滿同保濕 💦用完即刻好柔軟、有光澤、好有活力！

持續用咗一段時間之後，皮膚望落更明亮，毛孔望落更細，化妝時都貼服咗好多。

精華質地輕盈，完全唔黏笠，而且吸收得好快。味道都好柔和好放鬆 🫶🏻

如果係乾性或者暗沉皮膚，你一定要加入呢件嘢入你嘅護膚程序。

最後感想：一定會回購。呢款真係 work。

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask #Heartleaft Fit 10P
reviews.text: it’s lightweight yet nourishing, absorbs quickly, and leaves no greasiness or sticky residue. After six weeks of consistent use, my skin has noticeably improved, and even friends and colleagues have started asking what I changed in my routine!
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈但有滋潤感，吸收得好快，敷完之後完全冇油膩感或者黏笠嘅殘留物。持續用咗六個星期之後，皮膚明顯有改善，連朋友同同事都開始問我轉咗咩護膚程序！

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask Glutathiosome Fit 10P
reviews.text:
I rarely write long reviews for skincare products, but this one truly deserves every bit of praise. After trying countless creams, serums, and toners over the years, I finally found a product that not only lives up to its claims but actually exceeds my expectations. I’ve been using it consistently for a little over six weeks, and the results have been impressive enough that friends and colleagues started asking what I changed in my routine. For me, that was the first sign that this product was genuinely working—and not just giving me the usual short-term “skincare illusion.”

From the very first application, I noticed something different about the texture. It’s lightweight but still feels nourishing, almost like a perfect balance between a serum and a moisturizer. There’s no greasiness, no sticky residue, and it absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any film on the surface. I especially appreciate that because I have combination skin: oily in the T-zone but dry around the cheek
reviews.zh:
我好少為護膚品寫長篇評價，但呢一款真係值得所有讚美。多年嚟試過無數款面霜、精華同爽膚水之後，我終於搵到一款唔單止達到佢嘅聲稱效果，仲真正超出我預期嘅產品。我持續用咗大概六個幾星期，效果顯著到朋友同同事都開始問我改咗邊個護膚步驟。對我嚟講，呢個係產品真正起效嘅第一個信號——而唔係淨係畀到我一般嘅「短期護膚幻覺」。

由第一次用開始，我就留意到質地方面有啲唔同。佢輕盈但依然感覺有滋養，幾乎係精華同保濕霜之間嘅完美平衡。完全唔油笠、唔黏笠，而且快速被皮膚吸收，表面唔會留低任何薄膜。我特別欣賞呢一點，因為我係混合性肌：T字位出油，但面頰乾燥

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask Aqua Fit 10P
reviews.text: My all time favorite mask! I’ve been using this mask for few years now and it’s the best. I used it in the dry cold winters while living in Germany and it moisturizes skin deep, not just the surface.
reviews.zh: 我嘅終生最愛面膜！我用咗呢款面膜幾年，佢係最好嘅一款。以前喺德國生活嘅乾冷冬天都用佢，佢可以深層保濕皮膚，唔止表面咁淺。

reviews.shade: Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask Jericho Rose Fit 10P
reviews.text: This product is literally fantastic for dry skin, super hydrated, I feel like this is much better than other abib masks. I will recommend this product to everyone.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品對乾性肌嚟講真係一流，超級保濕，我覺得比其他 abib 面膜好好多。我會推薦畀所有人。
